The University of Miami and the University of Miami Health System seek an accomplished, strategic, and analytically sophisticated compensation executive to serve as Associate Vice President, Physician & Executive Compensation. This position provides enterprise leadership for the design, governance, administration, and strategic evolution of physician and executive compensation programs across the University and UHealth.

The Associate Vice President will serve as a trusted advisor to senior University and Health System leadership, including the President, Chief Executive Officer of UHealth, Chief Human Resources Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Medical Officer, deans, department chairs, and other executive leaders. The position will develop compensation strategies that attract, retain, motivate, and appropriately reward highly accomplished physicians, researchers, academic leaders, and executives while maintaining alignment with the University's academic mission, UHealth's clinical strategy, financial objectives, market competitiveness, and applicable regulatory requirements.

This leader will oversee the development and governance of physician compensation models across employed medical groups and clinical departments, as well as executive compensation programs for senior leaders. The position will establish consistent compensation philosophy, methodology, analytics, controls, and governance while recognizing the unique requirements of academic medicine, research, education, and clinical operations.

The Associate Vice President will also provide leadership for compensation-related transactions, including recruitment packages, leadership appointments, retention arrangements, incentive plans, organizational changes, affiliations, acquisitions, and other strategic initiatives.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Enterprise Compensation Strategy

Develop and implement an integrated University and UHealth physician and executive compensation strategy aligned with institutional priorities, strategic plans, financial objectives, and talent needs.

Establish and maintain compensation philosophies, principles, policies, methodologies, and governance frameworks for physician and executive compensation.

Advise senior leadership and governing committees on compensation strategy, competitiveness, affordability, internal equity, performance incentives, and emerging compensation trends.

Ensure compensation programs appropriately balance market competitiveness with financial sustainability and the University's academic, research, education, and clinical missions.

Develop long-term strategies for evolving physician and executive compensation in response to changes in healthcare delivery, reimbursement, academic medicine, labor markets, and regulatory requirements.

Physician Compensation

Provide strategic leadership for physician compensation across UHealth, including employed physicians, faculty physicians, advanced practice providers as appropriate, medical group leadership, department chairs, and other clinical leaders.

Oversee the development and administration of physician compensation plans incorporating appropriate measures of clinical productivity, quality, access, citizenship, academic contributions, research, teaching, leadership, and other institutional priorities.

Establish consistent methodologies for developing physician compensation plans while accommodating specialty-specific market conditions and clinical practice characteristics.

Partner with physician and operational leaders to evaluate compensation arrangements and recommend appropriate modifications.

Lead the analysis and development of physician recruitment, retention, leadership, and transition compensation arrangements.

Provide compensation guidance for new programs, service lines, clinical affiliations, acquisitions, joint ventures, and other strategic transactions.

Ensure physician compensation methodologies are supported by reliable market data, appropriate productivity benchmarks, and defensible analytical methodologies.

Develop and maintain tools, models, and dashboards that enable leaders to understand physician compensation performance, productivity, incentives, and market positioning.

Executive Compensation

Lead the design, evaluation, and administration of executive compensation programs for senior University and UHealth leaders.

Develop competitive executive compensation packages that support recruitment and retention of high-caliber leadership talent.

Conduct market benchmarking and internal equity analyses for executive positions.

Advise senior leadership and appropriate Board or Board committee members regarding executive compensation recommendations.

Coordinate executive compensation reviews, including base salary, incentive compensation, retention arrangements, deferred compensation, perquisites, and other executive benefits as appropriate.

Ensure executive compensation programs are appropriately documented, governed, and supported by independent market data and analysis.

Monitor emerging practices in executive compensation within leading academic medical centers, universities, and integrated health systems.

Compensation Governance & Compliance

Establish robust governance processes for physician and executive compensation across the University and Health System.

Ensure compensation programs and arrangements comply with applicable federal and state laws, regulations, tax requirements, healthcare regulatory requirements, and University policies.

Provide leadership regarding compensation compliance considerations, including Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute, Internal Revenue Code requirements, fair market value, commercial reasonableness, and applicable tax-exempt organization requirements.

Partner with Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, Finance, Tax, Human Resources, and other stakeholders to identify and mitigate compensation-related risk.

Develop appropriate documentation and approval processes for compensation arrangements.

Maintain appropriate controls, audit trails, and documentation supporting compensation decisions.

Serve as a key institutional resource during regulatory reviews, audits, due diligence, and other examinations involving physician or executive compensation.

Compensation Analytics & Market Intelligence

Establish an enterprise compensation analytics capability utilizing external market data, internal workforce data, productivity information, financial performance, and other relevant measures.

Select, evaluate, and manage external compensation surveys, benchmarking resources, consultants, and other market intelligence providers.

Analyze compensation data from leading academic medical centers, health systems, universities, and relevant physician specialty markets.

Develop sophisticated analytical models to evaluate compensation competitiveness, internal equity, productivity, incentive effectiveness, and financial impact.

Translate complex compensation analytics into clear recommendations for senior leaders and governing bodies.

Monitor market trends and proactively identify emerging compensation risks and opportunities.

Leadership & Organizational Partnership

Serve as a strategic partner to the Chief Human Resources Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Medical Officer, Chief Executive Officer of UHealth, academic leadership, and other senior executives.

Build strong relationships with deans, department chairs, clinical leaders, faculty leaders, finance leaders, HR business partners, and operational executives.

Lead and develop a high-performing compensation team with expertise in physician compensation, executive compensation, analytics, benchmarking, and compensation administration.

Establish service standards and consistent processes for responding to compensation requests and executive-level analyses.

Promote transparency, consistency, accountability, and sound governance while appropriately protecting confidential compensation information.

Collaborate with HR, Finance, Faculty Affairs, Medical Staff Affairs, Legal, Compliance, Revenue Cycle, Clinical Operations, and other functions to ensure effective execution of compensation programs.

Strategic Initiatives

Provide compensation leadership for major institutional initiatives, including organizational restructuring, physician practice acquisitions, affiliations, new service lines, expansion into new markets, and other strategic transactions.

Evaluate the compensation implications of changes in reimbursement models, value-based care, productivity expectations, and clinical practice structures.

Develop compensation strategies that support recruitment into strategically important specialties and areas of clinical need.

Support leadership succession planning and organizational design through compensation analysis.

Evaluate the effectiveness of existing compensation programs and recommend changes to improve alignment with institutional objectives.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, human resources, healthcare administration, or a related field.

Master's degree in business administration, healthcare administration, human resources, finance, or a related discipline strongly preferred.

10 or more years of progressively responsible experience in compensation, with significant experience in physician and/or executive compensation.

Demonstrated leadership experience within a complex healthcare system, academic medical center, university, or similarly complex organization.

Significant experience developing and administering physician compensation plans in an academic medicine or health-system environment.

Demonstrated experience with executive compensation benchmarking and strategy.

Strong knowledge of compensation principles, market benchmarking, incentive design, and compensation analytics.

Demonstrated understanding of healthcare compensation regulatory requirements, including fair market value, commercial reasonableness, Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute, and applicable tax requirements.

Experience presenting complex compensation recommendations to senior executives, physicians, governing committees, or boards.

Demonstrated ability to lead teams and manage highly confidential and sensitive information.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience within a large academic medical center or integrated academic health system.

Experience supporting both clinical and academic/faculty compensation.

Experience overseeing physician compensation for a large employed medical group.

Certified Compensation Professional (CCP), Certified Physician Practice Manager (CPPM), or other relevant professional certification preferred.

Experience with compensation analytics, financial modeling, and advanced data visualization.

Experience working with physician productivity methodologies and benchmarks, including wRVU-based compensation models.

Experience with executive compensation within a nonprofit or tax-exempt organization.

Experience working directly with Board committees or compensation committees.

Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, affiliations, joint ventures, or other healthcare transactions.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Exceptional strategic and analytical capabilities with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations.

Deep understanding of physician compensation and the economics of academic medicine.

Strong understanding of executive compensation principles and market practices.

Excellent financial modeling and quantitative analysis skills.

Strong knowledge of healthcare regulatory and compensation compliance requirements.

Exceptional communication and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex compensation matters to physicians, executives, and governing boards.

Strong executive presence, judgment, discretion, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to navigate complex organizational environments and balance competing priorities.

Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders without relying solely on formal authority.

Strong project management and organizational skills.

Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling highly sensitive compensation information.

Commitment to equity, consistency, transparency, and ethical compensation practices.

At Range, we’re building towards a world where anyone can live the financial life they imagine for themselves. If that sounds like a mission you want to be a part of, let’s create it together.

We’re building AI-powered wealth management. Investments, taxes, retirement, estate planning, all in one platform instead of scattered across different advisors and apps. We're backed by Google's Gradient Ventures, Cathay Innovation, Scale Venture Partners, and more. We’re growing fast while still small enough that everyone's work is visible and impactful.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Member Success Manager to join Range, who will lead outreach and engagement efforts with our members. Key aspects of the role include building relationships, gathering feedback on product usage, and driving initiatives to increase retention and long-term engagement. You will be the voice of our members internally, helping translate their needs, pain points, and feedback into actionable insights for product, operations, and customer-facing teams. This is a hands-on, high-impact position at the intersection of member engagement, feedback collection, and retention strategy.



We're excited to hire this role at Range's Headquarters in McLean, VA. All of our positions follow an in-office schedule Monday through Friday, allowing you to collaborate directly with your team. If you're not currently based in the area, but love what you see, let’s discuss relocation as part of your journey to joining us.




WHAT YOU’LL DO WITH US

 - Conduct proactive outreach to members (via email, phone calls, in-app messages, or other communication channels) to engage them, understand how they’re using Range, and encourage deeper engagement.

 - Collect qualitative and quantitative feedback on product functionality, usability, and overall member experience — for example, via surveys, interviews, or feedback sessions.

 - Analyze feedback and engagement data to identify patterns, pain points, and opportunities for improving the product and member journey.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Support teams to ensure feedback leads to actionable improvements.

 - Develop and implement member engagement and retention campaigns (onboarding follow-ups, check-ins, re-engagement campaigns, loyalty/advocacy programs, etc.).

 - Define and track key member-experience metrics (e.g., retention rate, engagement frequency, satisfaction scores) and report on those to leadership.

 - Help design and maintain feedback loops: regular member check-ins, surveys, focus groups, or other mechanisms to surface member sentiment over time.




WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - 5+ years of experience in customer experience, customer success, member engagement, or a similar role (ideally in a fintech, SaaS, or membership-based business).

 - BS or BA from a leading university

 - Strong communication skills — able to engage members with empathy, build rapport, and elicit honest feedback.

 - Analytical mindset: comfortable working with both qualitative and quantitative data to detect trends, draw insights, and make recommendations.

 - Cross-functional collaboration skills: able to work across Product, Engineering, and Support to translate insights into action.

 - Experience with feedback collection and member journey mapping (surveys, interviews, feedback mechanisms, journey maps, retention initiatives).

 - A member-centric mindset: you care deeply about understanding members’ needs, and you believe in shaping the product and experience around them.

This is the base salary range we expect in good faith to pay for this role at the time of posting. Where an offer lands within the range depends on the scope and complexity of work the candidate can own independently and demonstrated depth at this level.




OTHER COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

The range above reflects base salary only. Our offer packages also include equity in the form of stock options, so total compensation for this role will exceed the base salary range.

Customer Experience Advisor | S1 | Retail Banking | Gloucester Branch

Country: United Kingdom

IT STARTS HERE

Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.

This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

Retail & Commercial Banking is a global business integrating all our retail and commercial banking activities to better serve our customers, improve efficiency and drive value creation.

THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE 

Santander is looking for a Customer Experience Advisor based out of Gloucester Branch, working 35 hours per week, on a rota’d basis Monday to Saturday, between 8am & 6pm.

For our customers, you’ll be more than just the friendly face and voice of Santander. You’ll be a listener and problem solver. Whether you’re helping someone with a simple cash transaction, aiding them with technology in the banking hall, transacting with them over the phone or protecting your customers against fraud and scams, you’ll never know what the next challenge will be.

What’s not in doubt is that you’ll have plenty of support. Life in a branch can be busy, varied and challenging, so we’re a close-knit team.

You’ll be totally flexible in your approach and comfortable in undertaking a broad range of activities. This means not limiting your time and focus on one particular element of your role. You’ll thrive on the variety this gives you and take satisfaction for operating in a multi-skilled environment. You’re the eyes and ears of our business after all.

We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:

Acting as the first point of contact for customers in branch or over the phone

Assisting with day-to-day transactions, queries and servicing

Answering customer calls into our contact centre

Building relationships and finding solutions

Developing your knowledge of services and products to help our customers

Identifying new ways to improve the customer experience

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Professional Experience 

Proven ability to deliver outstanding customer service either from a face to face or a telephony background (Required)

The ability to communicate effectively with customers to truly understand their needs (Required)

A real desire to go above-and-beyond for customers (Preferred)

Effective team working skills with a flexible, can-do approach to work (Preferred)

Openness to a broad range of activities even if outside of standard expectations (Preferred)

Ability to grow, adapt and change accommodating business needs and priorities (Preferred)

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT

At Santander, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.

Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.

The starting salary is £25,000 together with a £500 flexible benefit allowance and the opportunity to earn a discretionary performance-related bonus of 8% of salary

25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, which increases to 26 days after 5yrs service, with the option to purchase up to 5 contractual days per year.

Voluntary healthcare benefits at discounted rates. Including: medical insurance, dental insurance, and health assessments

We put 8% of salary into your pension, even if you don’t contribute yourself. We’ll pay in up to 12.5% of salary, if you contribute as well, and you can take some of our contribution in cash if you prefer.

Protection for you and your family, with company-funded death-in-service benefit and income protection insurance, and the option to take advantage of discounted rates for additional life assurance and critical illness cover.

Share in Santander’s success by saving or investing in our share plans. 

As a Santander UK employee, you are able to request staff versions of our products like our Edge Current Accounts and Credit Cards with no fees, as well as apply to many other deals and discounts in Santander products and services

Competitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring.

Wellbeing that goes beyond work — we work with a range of wellbeing partners across our 4 pillars of wellbeing (physical, mental, social and financial) to give you access to a suite of apps, discounted gym and fitness access, weekly online classes, flexible healthcare and mental health support.

Support for every life stage — from menopause and pregnancy to parenthood and beyond, with enhanced family leave, childcare options and tailored wellbeing support.

Time to give back through volunteering opportunities that let you make a difference in the communities we serve.

Global growth opportunities to shape your career, learn new skills and explore what’s possible across our international network.

Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.

LOCAL COMPLIANCE

At Santander, we’re proud to be an inclusive organisation that provides equal opportunities for everyone — regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation.

We’re committed to creating a recruitment experience that’s accessible, fair and welcoming for all candidates.

We want our people to thrive — at work and at home — while delivering the best outcomes for our customers and supporting each other to grow.

When applying, please consider the travel distance, time and cost to your chosen Branch location.

Right to work in the UK

All candidates must have the right to work in the UK to commence employment with Santander.

WHAT TO DO NEXT

If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

If there’s anything we can do in the recruitment process to help you achieve your best, get in touch. Whether it’s a copy of our application form in another format or additional assistance, we’re available through email. You can contact us at resourcing@santander.co.uk

Job Title: Operations Batch Release Team Leader

Location: Waterford, Ireland

About the job

As a Operations Batch Release Team Leader, you play a critical operational leadership role within Lyo Operations, driving end-to-end batch release performance, deviation management, and cross-functional collaboration across internal teams and external stakeholders supporting Rare Disease, Rare Blood Disorder, and General Medicines.

You are accountable for ensuring that release cycle time targets - including Operational Cycle Time (OCT) and Plant Cycle Time (PCT) - are consistently achieved. You deliver this through strong cross-functional performance governance, structured deviation management, and by fostering a culture of effective collaboration.

You act as the central coordination point across all functions involved in the batch release process. While you are not directly accountable for the performance of other departments, you are responsible for establishing and maintaining the governance framework that enables each function to meet its commitments. This includes identifying performance gaps, escalating risks, and driving corrective actions where required.

Ready to get started?

Join a global network that powers how Sanofi delivers - seamlessly, purposefully, and at scale. In Manufacturing & Supply, you’ll help reimagine how life-changing treatments reach people everywhere, faster.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main responsibilities:

Batch Release & Cycle Time Performance

Own the end-to-end batch release process, ensuring all activities are completed within defined lead times to achieve OCT and PCT targets

Monitor and report on release cycle time performance, identifying bottlenecks and driving resolution across functions

Lead the Comments Clinic process to ensure all batch record comments are closed on time, eliminating risk to batch release

Serve as the APU lead for batch release process standards, ensuring alignment and compliance across the team

Support delivery of product-specific PCT targets (e.g., Myozyme, ALtuviiio etc) in collaboration with cross-functional partners

Cross-Functional Performance Governance

Design, implement, and maintain a performance governance framework that tracks lead time adherence across all functions contributing to batch release

Facilitate standard governance meetings (daily, weekly, and periodic cadences) to review performance, surface risks, and coordinate action

Hold functions accountable to their commitments through structured follow-up and escalation processes — without direct line accountability for those functions

Drive improvements in meeting effectiveness and cross-functional coordination efficiency

Serve as the primary escalation point for release-related performance issues requiring multi-functional resolution

Deviation Management

Provided combined management oversight for the Deviation Team (along with Head of PCU Engineering), ensuring all deviations are managed within defined lead times and closed on time or formally extended with appropriate justification

Facilitate daily and weekly deviation review meetings to drive timely closure and continuous reduction in open deviation volumes

Serve as the APU lead for deviation process standards, ensuring consistency and compliance across Operations, Engineering, and Quality functions

Maintain and improve deviation management compliance metrics, targeting sustained reduction in open and overdue deviations

People Leadership & Team Development

Lead, develop, and engage the Deviation Team, maintaining a high-performance culture aligned with Sanofi values

Maintain a structured training plan for the team, spanning Operations, Engineering, and Quality disciplines, with a target of ≥95% training compliance

Conduct regular 1:1s and team communications to ensure alignment, engagement, and development

Foster a strong safety culture, ensuring zero Lost Time Incidents (LTI) and full compliance with HSE standards, life-saving rules, and mandatory safety verifications (MSVs)

About you

Degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related discipline

Significant experience in a biopharmaceutical or pharmaceutical manufacturing environment, with direct exposure to batch release and/or quality operations

Demonstrated experience in cross-functional coordination or operational governance roles

Proven track record of leading continuous improvement initiatives, with measurable outcomes in cycle time, quality, or productivity

Experience managing or coordinating deviation, CAPA or Change Control processes in a GMP-regulated environment

Familiarity with external improvement frameworks (e.g., McKinsey Accelerator, Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent) is highly desirable

Strong data literacy - ability to build and interpret performance metrics and drive action from data

Experience leading or developing small-to-medium teams in an operational setting

Knowledge of Lyophilisation and associated processes or biologics manufacturing processes is an advantage

Why choose us?

Shape the future of medicine and vaccine delivery with cutting-edge technology, ensuring seamless launches and a resilient global supply.

Transform lives worldwide by delivering life-changing treatments anywhere, anytime.

Grow, thrive, and make an impact in a workplace that empowers you to bring your best self every day, with pride.

#LI-EUR

Pursue progress, discover extraordinary

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

The WIS department at BUMC-P is well known for our specialty programs for higher order multiples, placenta accreta management and OB critical care. As a patient care assistant on this unit, you will work directly with the unit RN staff to help deliver quality care to our patients and their families; leading to successful, optimal outcomes using the latest procedures and state of the art equipment.

This is a Full Time Night Shift working from 7pm-7:30am. 

You will have the opportunity utilize our self-scheduling tool for shift and weekend coverage.  Enjoy an 18%-night shift differential and a flat rate $1/hour weekend shift differential.

University Medical Center Phoenix is a nationally recognized academic medical center. The world-class hospital is focused on coordinated clinical care, expanded research activities and nurturing future generations of highly trained medical professionals. Our commitment to nursing excellence has enabled us to achieve Magnet™ recognition by the American Nurses Credentialing Center. The Phoenix campus, long known for excellent patient care, has over 730 licensed beds, several unique specialty units and is the new home for medical discoveries, thanks to our collaboration with the University of Arizona College of Medicine - Phoenix. Additionally, the campus responsibilities include fully integrated multi-specialty and sub-specialty clinics.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position provides routine patient care to promote patient comfort and contribute to the overall patient plan of care. This position is responsible for on-going patient data collection and documentation in the medical records and provides a variety of unit support functions which contribute to the overall efficient operation of the nursing unit/department.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Provides assistance in activities of daily living and completes necessary tasks to promote patient health, including assisting patients with basic hygiene needs, maintaining an optimum level of mobility and providing assistance with nutritional intake as needed.

2. Collects patient specimens and data, including vital signs, input/output and other delegated measurements in accordance with unit/facility policy and standards of care. Documents objective data and routine aspects of patient care. Assists in the transportation of patient specimens.

3. Recognizes and reports abnormalities and/or changes in the patient’s health status and responses to treatment to a licensed professional. Promotes continuity of care by accurately and completely communicating to other caregivers the status of patients for which care is provided.

4. Performs procedures and uses equipment as delegated by a licensed professional, consistent with demonstrated competencies and according to state scope of practice; procedures may include blood draws, foley catheters removal, EKGs, and EKG monitoring. Provides necessary supplies, support and assistance to medical staff and patients for unit specific procedures, under the direct supervision of a licensed professional.

5. Performs receptionist/clerical duties to support overall operating efficiency and effective flow of communication and information throughout the department. Participates in the resolution of customer problems or collects necessary data and follows through to appropriate person for problem resolution.

6. Maintains a complete patient record with admission, transfer, and discharge information, progress notes, and consent forms. Ensures that all reports and chart forms are scanned or filed into the patient’s record. Ensures that charting forms are labeled and accessible if they are needed. Maintains adequate supplies of frequently used, patient education materials. Assists in the ordering of patient specimens. May transcribe and process physician orders effectively using the electronic medical record.

7. Maintains adequate levels of office, dietary, and medical supplies and completes requisition forms when supplies need to be ordered. Reconciles supply order upon delivery. Monitors and tracks the use and whereabouts of electronic equipment such as patient ID scanners and lap top computers. Ensures that all are accounted for and in working order.

8. Based on area of assignment may assist with transporting patients, including pre-operative and immediate post-operative patients to critical care unit. Participates in OR room turnover.

9. This position works under supervision and has responsibility for assigned unit only. Incumbents work in a fast-paced, sometimes stressful environment with a strong focus on customer service. Interacts with staff at all levels throughout the facility, as well as patients, families and physicians

Performs all functions according to established policies, procedures, regulatory and accreditation requirements, as well as applicable professional standards. Provides all customers of Banner Health with an excellent service experience by consistently demonstrating our core and leader behaviors each and every day.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge.

Current BLS certification is required. Current Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) in state of practice is required for new hires and transfers. In Tucson: Current Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) in state of practice is required for new hires. Existing Tucson incumbents may not transfer out of their geographical market without meeting the CNA requirement. Requires skills and abilities typically attained with 1 year of medical clerical experience; preferably in a hospital or physician office setting, or prior experience in customer service. Must possess excellent organizational skills, as well as effective human relations and communication skills. Working knowledge of medical terminology and computer literacy and keyboarding skills is required.

Must possess excellent organizational skills, as well as effective human relations and communication skills. Working knowledge of medical terminology and computer literacy and keyboarding skills is required.

Depending on department assignment, receive a minimum passing score of 85% on ECG or EEG test with accurate identification of all lethal cardiac dysrhythmias and epileptiform activity is required. Successful completion of either a unit approved basic electrocardiogram interpretation course or electroencephalographic interpretation course, or on the job training is also required.

Employees working at Banner Behavioral Health Hospital, BTMC Behavioral, and BUMG, BUMCT, or BUMCS in a Behavioral Health clinical setting that serves children must possess an Arizona Fingerprint Clearance Card at the time of hire and maintain the card for the duration of their employment. An Arizona Criminal History Affidavit must be signed upon hire. Employees working for Banner Home Care AZ must possess an Arizona Fingerprint Clearance Card at the time of hire and maintain the card for the duration of their employment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
In Arizona the Licensed Nursing Assistant (LNA) licensure is preferred. Recent healthcare experience preferred. Successful completion of an approved unit secretary program is preferred.
Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Job Description

Maak impact met jouw werk, elke dag opnieuw! Wil jij werken in een omgeving waar technologie, teamwork en maatschappelijke impact samenkomen? Ga bij ons aan de slag als:

 

Bioprocess Technician

 

Welkom in ons team

In De Bilt zoeken we enthousiaste Bioprocess Technicians met oog voor detail, die willen bijdragen aan een innovatieve biotechomgeving. Op onze productielocatie maken we vaccins voor pluimvee die in meer dan 100 landen worden gebruikt. Zo verbeteren we dierenwelzijn én versterken we voedselzekerheid wereldwijd. 

Bij ons draait het om samenwerking en groei. Je werkt in een veilige en inspirerende omgeving met collega’s die verschillende kennis en ervaringen meebrengen. Zo blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen en lever je een directe bijdrage aan een betekenisvol doel

 

Over de functie

Als Bioprocess Technician speel je een belangrijke rol in het productieproces van onze vaccins. Samen met je collega’s werk je mee aan verschillende stappen binnen het proces, waarbij je altijd volgens strikte GMP‑ en veiligheidsrichtlijnen werkt. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met het voorbereiden en afvullen van vaccins in ampullen, het correct invriezen en opslaan van producten in vloeibaar stikstof en het bedienen van moderne apparatuur om de aseptische kwaliteit te waarborgen.

We zorgen voor een uitgebreide interne opleiding, zodat je goed voorbereid aan de slag kunt. Tijdens deze training leer je onder meer aseptisch werken in cleanrooms, veilig omgaan met apparatuur en werken volgens vastgestelde procedures en documentatie. Op die manier groei je uit tot een allround medewerker met afwisselend, betekenisvol werk, waarin je kunt blijven leren en je verder kunt ontwikkelen.

 

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden omvatten

Productie van vaccins in cleanrooms, met strikte naleving van GMP-voorschriften en werkdocumenten.

Actief deelnemen aan diverse processtappen, zowel binnen als buiten cleanrooms en werken met geautomatiseerde afvulmachines.

Kleine storingen zelfstandig oplossen en alle handelingen documenteren volgens GMP-richtlijnen.

Cruciale ondersteunende taken uitvoeren, zoals opbouwen van apparatuur en volgen van schoonmaakprocedures.

Afwijkingen signaleren, rapporteren en de impact inschatten.

Bijdragen aan teamwerk en procesverbeteringen, met focus op samenwerking en leren van fouten.

Werkinstructies en methodes in overleg met de proceseigenaar verbeteren.

 

Jouw profiel

Je hebt een afgeronde mbo-opleiding niveau 3 of 4, óf een hbo-opleiding, in een relevante richting (bijvoorbeeld Life Sciences, procestechniek, laboratoriumtechniek of vergelijkbaar).

Ervaring in een GMP-productieomgeving (zoals voeding, diervoeder of farmacie) is een pré, maar geen vereiste.

Je communiceert duidelijk en zorgvuldig in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Je bent gemotiveerd om te werken in een dynamische biotechomgeving en staat open voor het volgen van interne opleidingen en trainingen.

Je werkt nauwkeurig volgens voorschriften, kunt zelfstandig taken oppakken en durft initiatief te nemen wanneer dat past.

Je bent flexibel ingesteld en begrijpt dat werken in een moderne productieomgeving soms vraagt om aanpassing van werktijden. Je staat er daarom voor open om, indien nodig, in de toekomst werkzaamheden op afwijkende tijden te verrichten.

Voldoe je niet aan alle punten, maar breng je wel een relevante opleiding, motivatie en leergierigheid mee? Dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te solliciteren, we hechten veel waarde aan diversiteit, groei en ontwikkeling.

 

Werktijden

Week 1: Ma/wo/do: 12:30 - 21:00; Di/vr: 10:00 - 18:30

Week 2: Ma/wo/do: 12:30 - 21:00; Di/vr: 10:00 - 18:30

Week 3: Ma/wo/do: 14:00 - 22:30; Di/vr: 12:30 - 21:00

 

Wij bieden

Werken bij ons betekent samen werken aan gezondheid in een internationale werkomgeving met toegewijde collega’s. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en te laten zien wie jij bent. Verder kan je rekenen op aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Competitief salaris afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

3% eindejaarsuitkering en een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van eigen en bedrijfsresultaten.

Minimaal 35,5 verlofdagen.

Reiskostenvergoeding en een solide pensioenregeling.

Een bijdrage aan je persoonlijke sportabonnement ter ondersteuning van je vitaliteit.

Mentale welzijnsondersteuning via Lyra Health voor jou en je gezinsleden.

Een werkplek binnen een organisatie die continu groeit en zich door ontwikkelt.

Deze rol valt binnen de O-2 Mid schaal.

 

Animal Health

Onze Animal Health divisie is een vertrouwde wereldleider in veterinaire geneeskunde, gewijd aan het behoud en verbeteren van de gezondheid, het welzijn en de prestaties van dieren en de mensen die voor hen zorgen. Wij zijn een wereldwijd team van professionals dat samenwerkt om een positieve impact te maken in de dierenzorg en de voedselvoorziening in de wereld, en we hebben een diep gevoel van verantwoordelijkheid naar onze klanten, consumenten, dieren, de samenleving en onze planeet.
Door onze toewijding aan The Science of Healthier Animals® bieden wij dierenartsen, boeren, huisdiereigenaren en overheden een van de breedste assortimenten aan veterinaire geneesmiddelen, vaccins en oplossingen en diensten voor gezondheidsbeheer, evenals een uitgebreid aanbod van digitaal verbonden identificatie-, traceer- en monitoringsproducten. We investeren in dynamische en uitgebreide R&D-middelen en een moderne, wereldwijde toeleveringsketen. We zijn actief in meer dan 50 landen, terwijl onze producten beschikbaar zijn in ongeveer 150 markten.

Mechanic Engineer

As a Mechanic Engineer at JLL, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for the operation and maintenance of a premier commercial real estate property. You will perform essential maintenance, conduct routine assessments of all building systems, and ensure a safe, efficient, and comfortable environment for our tenants. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function:

Job Description:

About Orthopaedics

 

Fuelled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalised treatments.

 

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedic surgeries? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Orthopaedics Teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

 

Visit us at https://www.jnj.com/medtech to see how your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness.

 

The Opportunity

 

A permanent full-time opportunity has become available for a Product Specialist within our Joint Reconstruction Team in QLD. Based in Brisbane, you will partner with orthopaedic surgeons and theatre teams within the assigned territory to drive the adoption of our Hip & Knee replacement solutions including VELYS™, our cutting-edge robotic technology. By building strong clinical relationships, providing expert in-theatre support and delivering education and training, you will help improve patient outcomes while achieving sales growth and expanding market presence across your territory.

 

We welcome applications from NZ-based candidates with NZ Citizenship, who are seeking a career move and are open to relocating to Brisbane, Australia for this exciting opportunity.

 

Responsibilities

 

Driving sales growth and market share by developing strong clinical partnerships and executing strategic account plans across a designated territory

Providing expert clinical and in-theatre support, ensuring our current customers receive exceptional service and product expertise

Delivering education and training programs that support the adoption of our Hip & Knee replacement solutions and enhance patient outcomes

Building trusted relationships with orthopaedic surgeons, theatre teams, and key stakeholders, helping identify opportunities to grow and strengthen customer partnerships

Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver business objectives, maintaining customer satisfaction, and contributing to a high-performing, team-oriented culture

 

About You

 

Degree qualified with proven skills in orthopaedic sales and territory management, preferably in Hip & Knee Arthroplasty

Strong business acumen, an understanding of the local orthopaedic market, and a proven track record of building professional and strategic relationships

Exceptional planning skills, attention to detail and strong team orientation

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders

Ability to think strategically and constructively challenges customers

 

Why Choose Us

 

Competitive remuneration package

Continuous training and support

Award-winning leadership development programs

Inclusive, flexible, and accessible working arrangements

Equal opportunity employer supporting diversity and inclusion

 

Our Benefits

 

Up to 18 weeks of parental leave to support new parents

4 days of volunteer leave to give back to the community

Option to purchase up to 2 weeks of additional annual leave for extra time off

Enjoy a dedicated Wellbeing Day to prioritise self-care

Global Wellness Reimbursement of $780 per year for healthy eating, exercise, or mindfulness activities

Access to an Employee Assistance Program for personal and professional support

Enhanced leave provisions for compassionate (caregiver) leave, providing up to 30 days of additional support

Life insurance coverage for added peace of mind

 

And much more...

Job Description:

The Research Coordinator supports collaborative studies in the Development, Early Experience, and Resilience (DEER) Lab and the Connection, Affect, and Regulation of Emotion (CARE) Lab within the Department of Psychology at Bryn Mawr College. The DEER and CARE Labs investigate how children and adults regulate their thoughts, feelings, and behaviors. Current projects use experimental and observational methods to examine how parents can help their children effectively regulate emotions.  

About the Institution: Since its founding in 1885, Bryn Mawr College has been the preeminent college for women interested in the pursuit of wisdom necessary to challenge the world's expectations. With its pioneering American Collegiate Gothic architecture and picturesque landscape, our campus is recognized as one of the most beautiful in the country. Located less than 15 miles from Philadelphia, and within 2-3 hours of New York City, Baltimore, and Washington, DC, Bryn Mawr’s location offers easy access to public transportation and endless recreation, dining, retail, and cultural activities. 

Schedule & Benefits: Bryn Mawr is committed to building and sustaining a campus community where faculty and staff can thrive. This temporary, part-time, non-exempt position has an anticipated schedule of 20 hours per week, year-round (720 hours annualized). This position has an anticipated start date of September 8, 2026, and an anticipated end date of May 18, 2027, with the possibility of extending the position based on performance and continued funding.  

Position Responsibilities:  

Trained by the co-Principal Investigators (co-PIs) and will work with the co-PIs and undergraduate researchers to carry out collaborative funded projects.  

Maintaining a system to track participant consenting, participation, and study compensation across labs.  

Developing and carrying out study protocols, managing project databases, and research registries. 

Conducting check of data integrity.  

Coordinating events with community partners, including meetings of a community advisory board.  

Creating and distributing a community newsletter.  

Helping manager for additional study staff (e.g., undergraduate student research assistants). 

Other responsibilities as assigned.  

 

Qualifications:   

A bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Neuroscience, or related field.  

One year of relevant research experience in human subjects at the undergraduate or post-baccalaureate level.  

Excellent organizational and writing skills. 

The ability to work and problem-solve independently.  

Proficiency with data cleaning and analysis in Excel, R, or Python.  

Experience working with children and/or families.  

Coding experimental paradigms is strongly preferred but not required.  

Strong collaboration and leadership skills for working with undergraduate students are essential.  

Successful completion of satisfactory background checks.  

 

To apply, upload your complete application package as a single PDF document. A complete application package includes: 1) cover letter; 2) resume; and 3) names/contact information for three professional references. Application review will continue until the position is filled. We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title
Immigration Advisor

About your role:

As an Immigration Advisor, you will manage U.S. and Canada non-immigrant and immigrant visa processes that support associates, managers, HR Business Partners and internal mobility stakeholders. You will apply employment-based immigration knowledge to guide visa strategy, timelines, case progression and compliance. Your work will help Fiserv coordinate accurate, timely immigration and mobility support across business units.

 

What you'll do:

Advise HR Business Partners, associates, managers and business units on U.S. and Canada immigration options, processes, policies, regulatory updates, timelines and case requirements.

Manage U.S. non-immigrant and immigrant visa cases, including H-1B, E-3, L-1A/B, TN, PERM, I-140 and I-485, in collaboration with external immigration counsel.

Track immigration timelines, renewals, expiration dates and case milestones in the Global Mobility Case Management system to support proactive and compliant case progression.

Coordinate responses to immigration audits, Requests for Evidence and government inquiries, serving as the liaison between the business, managers and external counsel.

Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders to review projected spending, case volume, upcoming expirations, trends and process needs.

Partner with Global Mobility vendors and internal teams, including Corporate Tax, Payroll, Human Resources and Global Compensation, to coordinate international assignment logistics and benefits.

Provide leadership with feedback and recommendations related to immigration policies, processes, controls and case management practices.

Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

 

Experience you'll need to have:

6+ years of experience managing high-volume U.S. employment-based immigration cases, including non-immigrant and immigrant visa processes.

6+ years of experience advising stakeholders on immigration requirements, government procedures, case timelines and employment-based visa strategy.

Experience managing cases involving H-1B, E-3, L-1A/B, TN, PERM, I-140 and I-485 processes in partnership with external immigration counsel.

Experience using a case management system to track immigration milestones, renewals, expiration dates, documentation and case status.

Proficiency coordinating immigration audit responses, Requests for Evidence and government inquiries with business stakeholders and external counsel.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human Resources, Legal Studies, Business Administration or a related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

 

Experience that would be great to have:

In-house immigration experience within a multinational company supporting a global associate population.

Experience with Canadian employment-based immigration processes, global mobility programs or international assignment concepts.

Certified Relocation Professional, Global Mobility Specialist, Professional in Human Resources, Senior Professional in Human Resources or Global Professional in Human Resources certification, or equivalent certification.

Experience preparing petition materials or reviewing employment-based immigration documentation for accuracy and completeness.

 

How you'll work:

This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment.

 

Sponsorship:

You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role.

Job Description

Product Manager – Pagero

Our customers send and receive invoices, but not always digitally. Some arrive on paper or as an emailed PDF, and some have to reach a customer's online bank or digital mailbox. Could you help make sure every document gets where it's going?

You will join the team that ensures our customers can trade with businesses and consumers who don't send or receive standard e-invoices, taking ONESOURCE Pagero beyond markets with e-invoicing mandates and delivering growth through global reach. You will work in both directions: enabling customers to receive invoices and orders, that arrive on paper or email, and to send invoices in print, by email, or, in the Nordics, to a customer's online bank or digital mailbox. These services combine Pagero's invoice expertise with specialist sub-processors, including AI solutions.

You will report to the Director of Product Management. If you already know Pagero from integration, services or support, you'll have a head start, and if you're new to it, you'll learn quickly. This role suits someone early in their product career, and you will learn from experienced Product Managers. As your skills and ownership grow, you will take on more responsibilities.

ONESOURCE Pagero is Thomson Reuters’ solution for e-invoicing and digital business document exchange. Businesses connect once to the open Pagero Network to send and receive compliant e-invoices and other business documents, such as purchase orders, with their customers, suppliers and tax authorities, whatever systems they use.

Key Responsibilities

In this opportunity as Product Manager - Pagero, you will:

Help provide, manage and grow the services, from paper and PDF invoice and order capture to print and delivery to banks and digital mailboxes, by researching markets and competitors, building business cases for new markets, channels and service tiers, and contributing to how each is priced, packaged and improved

Learn from customers by joining customer meetings and drawing out patterns from what Sales, Support and Professional Services hear

Apply product judgement by forming your own view of what good looks like, speaking up if something falls short, and spotting how a change at a sub-processor, in our platform or in a delivery channel affects customers, cost and other teams

Grow into ownership by bringing proposals and not just problems, taking on defined parts of the portfolio and, over time, sub-processor relationships

Required Qualifications

Early career experience in product, operations, analysis or a customer-facing technology role, including internships or projects, that shows you learn fast and deliver

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are hiring a Managing Director to lead the strategy, delivery, and enterprise‑scale adoption of agent‑based automation across global financial services operations. This role sits within the Global Delivery Simplification organization and is accountable for transforming how complex, control‑intensive operational processes are executed using agentic AI in a highly regulated environment.

The Managing Director will own the end‑to‑end product portfolio for agent‑driven solutions across Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody, with full accountability for value realization, risk posture, and sustained operational performance at scale.

This role combines senior product leadership, people management, and executive‑level stakeholder accountability, requiring strong judgment, organizational influence, and ownership of outcomes well beyond initial delivery.

ROLE PURPOSE

The Managing Director leads multiple cross‑functional PODs responsible for conceiving, delivering, scaling, and governing agentic AI solutions across core business services including Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody.

The role is accountable for enterprise‑level product strategy, investment prioritization, roadmap governance, and value realization of agent‑based automation, ensuring solutions deliver material operational impact while meeting regulatory, audit, data governance, and model risk management expectations.

Success in this role requires the ability to set clear strategic direction, balance innovation with operational resilience, and institutionalize controls, auditability, and explainability as non‑negotiable product standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own enterprise‑level business outcomes for agent‑based automation, including efficiency, capacity, quality, client experience, and risk reduction.
• Define and communicate the long‑term vision and strategy for agentic AI across global operations.
• Set strategic priorities across Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody based on materiality, risk, and value.
• Sponsor identification and sequencing of high‑impact automation opportunities across the operating model.
• Ensure alignment of product strategy with regulatory expectations, enterprise AI risk frameworks, and control standards.
• Govern translation of simplification objectives into coherent product portfolios, roadmaps, and investment cases.
• Provide executive oversight of agile delivery, ensuring consistency of standards, outcomes, and operational readiness across PODs.
• Own the full lifecycle governance of agentic AI solutions, including approval frameworks, human‑in‑the‑loop models, escalation design, and decommissioning decisions.
• Establish enterprise standards for controls, auditability, explainability, and evidence capture in agent‑based solutions.
• Set materiality thresholds, risk tolerances, and escalation models for autonomous and semi‑autonomous execution.
• Make portfolio‑level decisions to scale, pause, remediate, or retire agents based on performance, risk, and value realization.
• Oversee production performance management including accuracy trends, systemic failure patterns, and control effectiveness.
• Lead and develop senior Product Owners and product leaders, setting clear expectations and accountability for outcomes.
• Partner with senior operations, risk, compliance, audit, data, and technology leaders to ensure enterprise alignment.
• Define, track, and report value realization, risk metrics, and control outcomes to executive governance forums.
• Represent Global Delivery Simplification in senior leadership discussions related to AI strategy, operational resilience, and regulatory engagement.

SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES
• Advanced product leadership capability, including portfolio strategy, investment governance, and organizational alignment.
• Exceptional judgment in balancing automation ambition, operational risk, regulatory scrutiny, and reputational considerations.
• Proven experience leading and developing senior product and delivery leaders.
• Executive‑level communication and influencing skills across business, technology, and control functions.
• Deep expertise in one or more operational domains (Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, or Custody) with enterprise perspective.
• Strong understanding of agentic AI risk, evaluation, monitoring, and control design at scale.
• Ability to interpret enterprise‑level telemetry, systemic risk signals, and performance trends.
• Deep understanding of data governance, model risk management, and audit expectations in regulated environments.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

• 12+ years of experience leading products, platforms, or transformations in complex, regulated operational environments.
• Senior leadership experience in global financial services operations.
• Demonstrated ownership of enterprise‑scale automation or AI portfolios.
• Extensive experience working with risk, compliance, audit, and regulators.
• Proven track record of scaling solutions into sustained business‑as‑usual operations.
• Experience operating in product‑centric, agile organizations at scale.

In this role, you will oversee geospatial data workflows and contribute to the development, publication, validation, and maintenance of GIS products supporting government mission requirements. Your responsibilities will include: Acquire, receive, organize, process, update, and maintain geospatial and operational datasets supporting DHS mission programs. Prepare datasets for upload, publication, visualization, analysis, sharing, archiving, and retrieval across ESRI Portal, ArcGIS Online, GII repositories, and other approved environments. Perform routine geoprocessing and spatial analysis, including data conversion, coordinate validation, field mapping, joins, selections, and overlays. Query and maintain archived geospatial information using accessible standards while supporting data backup, recovery, and records-retention activities. Apply established naming conventions, folder and repository structures, versioning practices, access restrictions, and data-handling procedures. Conduct quality assurance and quality control checks to verify data completeness, accuracy, consistency, currency, schema compliance, geometry, attribution, and usability. Document quality findings, corrections, assumptions, limitations, data lineage, and unresolved issues, escalating significant concerns when necessary. Create and maintain dataset, service, and database metadata in accordance with approved DHS geospatial methodologies, standards, and procedures. Support metadata design, repository maintenance, data dictionaries, field definitions, source descriptions, terms of use, points of contact, and update schedules. Reconcile published layers, web services, source datasets, metadata, and supporting documentation to maintain accuracy and traceability. Design, configure, publish, and maintain web maps, hosted feature layers, and geospatial services in accordance with technical and governance requirements. Configure symbology, labels, pop-ups, filters, fields, scales, legends, and other presentation settings to meet user and mission needs. Create and update ArcGIS Dashboards to communicate real-time information, key performance indicators, operational status, trends, and relevant context. Support Experience Builder applications and other ESRI web experiences by configuring maps, widgets, data sources, layouts, and user-facing content. Validate published GIS products to ensure accurate information, reliable performance, accessibility, security, and usability. Participate in stakeholder discussions and translate mapping, data, visualization, and reporting requirements into Jira stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, and data specifications. Execute manual and automated test cases for data workflows, maps, layers, dashboards, services, and geospatial applications, documenting results and defects. Support user acceptance, integration, regression, data-quality, and operational testing, verifying that corrections meet defined requirements. Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, reviews, and retrospectives, while keeping Jira tasks and blockers up to date. Use Confluence, GitLab, and other government-approved tools to maintain documentation, scripts, configurations, decisions, and project deliverables. At least 10 years of relevant professional, internship, academic, military, or project experience in GIS, geospatial analysis, cartography, data management, or location intelligence. Subject matter expertise with ESRI technologies, such as ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise/Portal, ArcGIS Online, web maps, hosted feature layers, and Dashboards, or comparable GIS platforms. Solid understanding of spatial data concepts, coordinate systems, projections, geocoding, vector and raster data, attributes, metadata, data quality, and fundamental spatial analysis. Experience working with common tabular, JSON, web-service, and geospatial data formats, including the ability to organize, validate, and maintain datasets systematically. Basic experience with Python, ArcGIS Notebooks, SQL, Arcade, or another scripting or query language used for data processing and GIS automation. Strong analytical reasoning and attention to detail, particularly when validating datasets, identifying inconsistencies, and documenting findings. Excellent organizational, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and learn within an Agile environment. Ability to satisfy DHS suitability requirements, including background investigation, Entry on Duty, security procedures, and system-access requirements applicable to the position. Ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance. Benefits Fully remote work arrangement within the United States. Full-time employment supporting federal government mission programs. Opportunity to contribute to meaningful geospatial initiatives supporting the Department of Homeland Security. Exposure to enterprise GIS technologies, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Dashboards, and Experience Builder. Collaborative Agile working environment with opportunities to contribute to technical solutions, data quality, and geospatial application development.

Job Description Summary
GE Vernova’s Power Conversion & Storage business is at the forefront of the energy transition. We are seeking several highly skilled Senior AI Engineers to join our teams to design, develop, and deliver AI-driven solutions that improve efficiency and decision-making across our business.
In this role, you will collaborate closely with domain experts and cross-functional teams to apply artificial intelligence, generative AI, and machine learning to real-world industrial challenges, helping accelerate innovation, productivity, and operational excellence.
A defining part of the role is technical judgment; choosing the right tool for each problem: classical machine learning, deep learning, GenAI, or pure software development when needed.

Job Description

AI & ML Solution Development & Integration

Design, develop, and implement AI solutions, including generative AI, machine learning models, neural networks, and optimization algorithms, to improve business process efficiency and effectiveness.

Select the appropriate modelling approach for each problem and articulate the trade-offs behind that choice.

Own the machine learning lifecycle: dataset construction, metrics definition, acceptance criteria in accordance with the stakeholders needs, evaluation strategies.

Translate business and operational needs into scalable AI-enabled tools, applications, and workflows.

Support the deployment and integration of AI/ML models into existing business and technical systems, software environments, and products where applicable, including monitoring for drift, performance degradation, and running cost.

Technical Implementation & Architecture

Collaborate with domain experts to identify high-value use cases and define technical requirements for AI solutions.

Define and document the solution architecture end to end: from data sources to the integration with the existing enterprise and technical IT landscape.

Design cloud-ready and on-premises solutions aligned with company IT, cybersecurity and data-governance standards.

Integrate AI/ML capabilities into hardware, software, and business process ecosystems in a way that supports reliability, usability, and maintainability.

Contribute to the development of robust, production-ready AI solutions suitable for industrial environments.

Solution Delivery, Partner & Contractor Management

Write clear technical specifications, statements of work, and acceptance criteria for work delivered by external contractors, software vendors, or internal digital teams.

Contribute to supplier, platform, and tool selection through structured technical evaluation, benchmarking, and proof-of-concept comparison.

Steer and review the work of internal & external partners: technical follow-up, design reviews, code and model reviews, quality gates, and acceptance testing; remaining the technical owner and guardian of the delivered solution.

Ensure solutions remain maintainable after handover through documentation, knowledge transfer, and clearly assigned ownership, so that delivered tools do not become orphaned.

Data Strategy & Analytics

Lead or support the collection, processing, structuring, and analysis of large-scale operational and business data.

Assess data readiness ahead of any development (availability, quality, labelling needs, access rights, confidentiality) and define strategies to close the gaps.

Identify patterns, trends, and performance improvement opportunities using advanced analytics and AI methods.

Develop data-driven solutions such as predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, quality and performance prediction, forecasting, cost analysis,  document and requirement analysis, and knowledge support tools.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with technical, operational, business and IT teams to ensure AI solutions meet business and industry requirements for safety, reliability, performance, and scalability.

Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Help align AI initiatives with business priorities, operational goals, and constraints.

Support end-user adoption: training, onboarding, feedback loops and measurement of the benefits realized once the solution is live.

Continuous Innovation

Evaluate emerging technologies such as edge AI, synthetic data, reinforcement learning, and large language models for industrial and business applicability.

Stay current with developments in AI, machine learning, and digital tools, and recommend practical adoption opportunities.

Maintain an active technology watch on the AI tooling landscape and filter it, distinguishing capability gains from hype before proposing adoption.

Contribute to building an innovation-oriented culture through knowledge sharing, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

Your Profile

Education

Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.

Experience

Overall 8+ Years pf experience.

Several years (2 to 4) of professional experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, software engineering, or a comparable technical role.

Experience developing and deploying AI/ML solutions in industrial, technical, or other complex operational environments is preferred.

Technical Expertise

Strong programming skills in Python, C++, or similar languages, and proficiency with modern development environments such as VS Code.

Hands-on experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and/or PyTorch, as well as classical ML tooling (e.g. scikit-learn, gradient boosting methods).

Experience with time-series analysis, optimization methods, and data-driven model development.

Practical experience with GenAI and their surrounding stacks (RAG, vector databases, A2A)

Experience handling unstructured data; technical documents, specifications, reports; alongside structured and tabular data.

Solid grounding in cloud services and architecture (Azure, AWS)

Working knowledge of data engineering fundamentals: SQL, data pipelines, and structured/unstructured data handling.

Familiarity with MLOps practices, model deployment, and integration into production environments is an advantage.

Domain Knowledge

Sound knowledge of artificial intelligence, combined with a strong interest in emerging technologies and digital trends.

Understanding of industrial processes, electrification, power systems, or related technical domains, or business processes, is an advantage.

Awareness of the regulatory and governance context around AI (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR) is a plus.

Experience in innovation management and/or patent-related work is a plus.

Personal Attributes

Proven ability to translate complex business and technical challenges into practical, scalable AI-driven solutions.

Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with a high degree of self-motivation and a structured, goal-oriented working style.

Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.

Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across functions and disciplines.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
